title: ABBALifelongLearningCertificationLoop
rules: ABBA may learn and practice without granting itself credentials.
Assessment evidence and certification records must retain provenance.
External certification authority is distinct from ABBA reasoning.
Unverified learning remains provisional and cannot silently become certified competency.
A credential describes verified achievement; it does not itself grant operational authority.
Capability updates do not imply permission or authority.
Learning history is append-oriented and corrections preserve prior provenance.
Reassessment continues after certification as knowledge and standards evolve.
